# Swift Chat Server

The backend for Swift Chat (https://unionst.com/swiftchat), deployed to your own Vercel account with your own Postgres and Blob store. Source and setup: https://github.com/unionst/swift-chat-server. Swift client: product `SwiftChatClient` from the same repository. This file is the complete API reference and is served from every deployment at /llms.txt.

## Concepts

- A **user** has an `id` (ours, `usr_…`) and an `external_id` (yours). Your backend creates users and mints their tokens through the admin API; the app never sees the server secret.
- A **conversation** has participants. One with no name and exactly two members is **direct** and is found again by the pair (`direct: true`). Any other is a group: it can be named, given a photo, and people can be added or can leave.
- A **message** has a per-conversation `seq` (1, 2, 3…), `text`, `media` (attachments uploaded to Blob), `data` (any JSON you want to carry, up to 16 KB, for cards and app-specific payloads), an optional `client_id` for idempotent sends, and `reactions`.
- Each participant has `read_seq` and `delivered_seq`. Your bubble is Delivered when every other participant's `delivered_seq` ≥ its seq, Read when every `read_seq` is.
- Each user has an **event log** ordered by `event_seq`. The stream replays it from a cursor, so nothing is missed across reconnects.

## Authentication

- User routes (`/v1/*`): `Authorization: Bearer <user token>`. Tokens are minted by `POST /admin/users` or `POST /admin/users/:id/token`, or by `POST /v1/users/anonymous` when `ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_USERS=1`.
- Admin routes (`/admin/*`): `Authorization: Bearer <SWIFT_CHAT_SECRET>`.
- Errors are JSON: `{"error": "<sentence for a person>", "code": "<snake_case>"}` with a 4xx/5xx status.

## Objects

User
```
{"id": "usr_…", "external_id": "user_42", "name": "Alice", "avatar_url": "https://…" | null}
```

Message
```
{"id": "msg_…", "conversation_id": "cnv_…", "seq": 12, "sender_id": "usr_…" | null,
 "text": "hey", "media": [Media], "client_id": "…" | null, "data": {…},
 "created_at": "2026-10-07T20:15:00.000Z",
 "reactions": [{"user_id": "usr_…", "emoji": "❤️", "part": "message" | "media"}]}
```
A `sender_id` of null is a system message.

Media
```
{"url": "https://….public.blob.vercel-storage.com/…", "kind": "image" | "file",
 "name": "…", "size": 12345, "width": 1600, "height": 1200}
```
`name`, `size`, `width`, `height` are optional. Only URLs on your Blob store are accepted from users unless `ALLOW_EXTERNAL_MEDIA=1`; the admin API accepts any https URL.

Conversation (as seen by the requesting user)
```
{"id": "cnv_…", "name": "The Crew" | null, "photo_url": "https://…" | null, "direct": false,
 "created_at": "…", "last_seq": 40, "last_message_at": "…", "last_message": Message | null,
 "unread": 3,
 "me": {"read_seq": 37, "delivered_seq": 40, "muted": false},
 "participants": [{"user": User, "read_seq": 40, "delivered_seq": 40, "typing": false, "joined_at": "…"}]}
```

## User API (/v1)

GET /v1
Health. `{"name": "swift-chat-server", "version": "…", "docs": "…"}`

POST /v1/users/anonymous
Only when `ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_USERS=1`. Body `{"name"?: string, "avatar_url"?: string}`. Returns `{"user": User, "token": string}`.

GET /v1/me
`{"user": User, "event_seq": number}`

PATCH /v1/me
Body `{"name"?: string | null, "avatar_url"?: string | null}`. Returns `{"user": User}`.

GET /v1/users?q=&ids=&external_ids=
Directory search (off when `USER_DIRECTORY=0`). `q` matches names; `ids` and `external_ids` are comma-separated. Anonymous users are hidden unless asked for by id. Returns `{"users": [User]}`.

POST /v1/devices
Body `{"token": "<hex APNs token>", "environment": "production" | "sandbox"}`. Returns `{"ok": true}`.

DELETE /v1/devices/:token
Returns `{"ok": true}`.

GET /v1/conversations
`{"event_seq": number, "conversations": [Conversation]}` sorted by `last_message_at` descending. Call this first; `event_seq` is the cursor to start the stream from.

POST /v1/conversations
Body `{"member_ids"?: [string], "member_external_ids"?: [string], "name"?: string, "photo_url"?: string}`. The caller is always a member. With no name and one other member this finds or creates the direct conversation. Returns `{"conversation": Conversation, "created": boolean}`.

GET /v1/conversations/:id
`{"conversation": Conversation}`. 404 if the caller is not a member.

PATCH /v1/conversations/:id
Body `{"name"?: string | null, "photo_url"?: string | null, "muted"?: boolean}`. `muted` is per caller. Naming a direct conversation makes it a group. Returns `{"conversation": Conversation}`.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/members
Body `{"member_ids"?: [string], "member_external_ids"?: [string]}`. New members start with `read_seq` and `delivered_seq` at the current end. Returns `{"conversation": Conversation}`.

DELETE /v1/conversations/:id/members/:userId
Removes a member (`me` for the caller). The last member leaving deletes the conversation. Returns `{"ok": true}`.

DELETE /v1/conversations/:id
The caller leaves. Returns `{"ok": true}`.

GET /v1/conversations/:id/messages?after_seq=&before_seq=&limit=
Without parameters: the newest `limit` (default 50, max 200) messages, oldest first. `before_seq` pages older; `after_seq` pages newer. Returns `{"messages": [Message], "has_more": boolean, "conversation": Conversation}`.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/messages
Body `{"text"?: string, "media"?: [Media], "data"?: object, "client_id"?: string}`. At least one of text, media or data. A repeat with the same `client_id` returns the original message instead of a duplicate. Returns `{"message": Message, "conversation": Conversation}`. Pushes every other participant who is not muted.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/read
Body `{"seq": number}`. Advances the caller's `read_seq` (never backwards, never past `last_seq`). Returns `{"ok": true}`.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/delivered
Body `{"seq": number}`. Normally unnecessary: the stream and push mark delivery themselves. Returns `{"ok": true}`.

POST /v1/conversations/:id/typing
Body `{"typing": boolean}`. Typing holds for 8 seconds; send again every ~5 seconds while typing and `false` when done. Returns `{"ok": true}`.

PUT /v1/conversations/:id/messages/:messageId/reaction
Body `{"emoji": string | null, "part"?: "message" | "media"}`. One reaction per person per part; null removes it. Returns `{"message_id": string, "reactions": [Reaction]}`.

POST /v1/uploads
Raw body, `Content-Type` set to the file's type, optional `X-Filename`. Up to 4 MB. Returns `{"url": string}` to use in `media`.

GET /v1/stream?after=<event_seq>
Server-Sent Events. `after` (or `Last-Event-ID`) is the cursor; `0` replays the whole log (14 days are kept). Events carry `id: <event_seq>` when durable. The stream says `bye` after 270 seconds; reconnect from your cursor.
- `hello` `{"cursor": number, "user_id": string}`
- `message` `{"conversation_id": string, "message": Message}`
- `receipt` `{"conversation_id": string, "user_id": string, "delivered_seq": number, "read_seq": number}`
- `reaction` `{"conversation_id": string, "message_id": string, "reactions": [Reaction]}`
- `conversation_updated` `{"conversation_id": string}` — fetch GET /v1/conversations/:id
- `conversation_removed` `{"conversation_id": string}`
- `typing` `{"conversation_id": string, "user_id": string, "typing": boolean, "hold_seconds": 8}` (not durable, no id)
- `ping` `{}` every 15 seconds when idle

## Admin API (/admin)

POST /admin/users
Body `{"external_id": string, "name"?: string, "avatar_url"?: string, "token_lifetime_seconds"?: number}`. Upserts by `external_id` (name and avatar update when given). Returns `{"user": User, "token": string}`. Tokens last a year by default.

POST /admin/users/:id/token
`:id` is ours or your `external_id`. Body `{"token_lifetime_seconds"?: number}`. Returns `{"token": string}`.

GET /admin/users/:id
`{"user": User}`

GET /admin/users/:id/conversations
`{"conversations": [Conversation]}` from that user's point of view.

DELETE /admin/users/:id
Removes the user from every conversation and deletes them. Their messages stay with `sender_id: null`.

POST /admin/conversations
Body `{"member_ids"?: [string], "member_external_ids"?: [string], "name"?: string, "photo_url"?: string}`. Returns `{"conversation": Conversation, "created": boolean}`.

GET /admin/conversations/:id
`{"conversation": Conversation}`

POST /admin/conversations/:id/members
Body as above. Returns `{"member_ids": [string]}`.

DELETE /admin/conversations/:id/members/:userId
Returns `{"ok": true, "member_ids": [string]}`.

GET /admin/conversations/:id/messages?after_seq=&before_seq=&limit=
`{"messages": [Message], "has_more": boolean}`

POST /admin/conversations/:id/messages
Body `{"sender_id"?: string, "sender_external_id"?: string, "text"?: string, "media"?: [Media], "data"?: object, "client_id"?: string, "created_at"?: ISO date}`. No sender means a system message. `created_at` backdates a message, for imports. Returns `{"message": Message}`.

POST /admin/conversations/:id/typing
Body `{"user_id" | "user_external_id", "typing": boolean}`.

POST /admin/conversations/:id/read
Body `{"user_id" | "user_external_id", "seq": number}`.

## Environment

DATABASE_URL (pooled Postgres), DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED (direct, for LISTEN), SWIFT_CHAT_SECRET, BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN, ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_USERS, USER_DIRECTORY, ALLOW_EXTERNAL_MEDIA, APNS_TEAM_ID, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_KEY, APNS_BUNDLE_ID. See the README for what each does.

## Swift client in one screen

```swift
import SwiftChat
import SwiftChatClient

let client = ChatClient(baseURL: URL(string: "https://your-deployment.vercel.app")!)
try await client.signIn(token: tokenFromYourBackend)      // or signInAnonymously(name:)

ConversationView(client: client, conversationID: id)      // a complete thread
ConversationRow(client: client, conversation: c)          // an inbox row

client.conversations, client.messages(in:), client.typingRoles(in:)
client.send(text:media:data:in:), client.markRead(_:), client.setTyping(_:in:)
client.toggleReaction(_:on:part:in:), client.loadOlder(in:)
client.startConversation(with:externalIDs:name:), client.addMembers(_:to:), client.rename(_:to:), client.setMuted(_:in:), client.leave(_:)
client.searchUsers(_:), client.registerDevice(token:), client.updateProfile(name:avatarURL:), client.signOut()
client.transcriptRow(for:lastOutgoingID:in:), client.contextMenuItems(for:in:)   // for a custom transcript
```
